gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-allerta: Bold stencil bridges and tall lowercase give Snowburst One its loud, cut-from-a-sheet look. Allerta sits underneath in wide, loose sans letters, and if the heading shrank, that stencil punch would fade fast.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-alumni-sans: Alumni Sans is slim and friendly, its ascenders barely rising above the lowercase body. Alumni Sans gives Snowburst One's chunky stencil heading room to shout while it stays quietly in the background.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-alumni-sans-pins: Stencil bridges cut across Snowburst One, and the gaps in its letters feel like a sheet punched out by hand. Alumni Sans Pinstripe follows in sans-serif with one uniform line and tight word shapes, so paragraphs read as steady, compact texture.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Chunky, stencilled, loud: Snowburst One looks cut from a metal sheet, with tall lowercase. Alumni Sans SC is the squeezed, plain sans partner, and its size is the lever to pull when the text needs more presence.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-anaheim: Snowburst One brings stencil bridges and a wide, paper-clip opening to the heading, tall in the lowercase. Anaheim follows in rounded sans-serif forms that fill the line like capitals, and bumping its size up a little would keep that dense texture readable.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-arsenal: Cut-out stencil swagger meets a tidy, close-set text face. Arsenal runs as a plain sans with x-height near cap height and a gentle weight shift, so extended reading feels smooth and compact.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC is a clean, contemporary sans with a faint thick-thin shift, tight fit and wide mouths on its letters. Snowburst One is best at stencil drama, while the body font simply carries the text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-asimovian: Asimovian has tall lowercase and one stroke width, like bent tubing of a single gauge, which makes it approachable. Snowburst One handles the stencil spectacle, but the body font does the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-basic: A stencil sheet with wide bridges and tall lowercase makes Snowburst One instantly recognizable. Basic follows in sans-serif, a gentle step from small letters to capitals, quietly keeping order.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-cal-sans: Expressive stencil bridges and tall lowercase make Snowburst One a loud opener with an unusually wide opening. Cal Sans keeps a single stroke width in sans-serif, with a tall x-height that makes a long paragraph feel smooth.
